expectations.text: Each claim about ajv and zod is attributed to a source or explicitly marked as not verified when the source could not be read here
expectations.evidence: Before the claims, the note gives one general caveat: "the points below come from the libraries' public docs as I know them. I haven't checked them against live pages here." Individual claims also name a doc page (ajv.js.org/json-schema.html, zod.dev/json-schema) or a file path to check, and the JSO

expectations.text: The note distinguishes that ajv validates JSON Schema documents (with draft 2020-12 support via its 2020 build) while zod defines schemas in code rather than validating JSON Schema documents
expectations.evidence: The note says "Draft 2020-12 needs its own class... require(\"ajv/dist/2020\")" and "Schemas are built in code (`z.object(...)`), and Zod validates data against those, not against JSON Schema documents."
